name: Hymenoptera’s Hand
body:
Price 2,400 gp; Aura faint transmutation; CL 3rd; Weight 1 lb.

DESCRIPTION

Five retractable syringes are concealed within the knuckles of this black and yellow striped leather glove. As part of a successful melee touch attack, the wearer of hymenoptera’s hand may pierce the targeted creature with one of these syringes as a swift action. The poison or potion stored in the selected syringe is injected into the target creature. In addition, the glove’s wearer gains a +4 competence bonus on checks made to craft poisons and can never accidentally poison herself.

The wearer can refill one syringe as a standard action. Doing so provokes an attack of opportunity.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 1,200 gp; Feats Craft Wondrous Item; Spells poison use
